_meta.note: PROVISIONAL — CANONICAL 2-ENCOUNTER SLICE RUN (KAN-4 run engine, decision log #31). The authored demo run the RunState engine consumes verbatim: encounter 1 is the tutorial-floor brood skirmish where the party meets Sasha (staged as a party-side ally NPC — decision #31's staging default: the recruit FIGHTS the offer encounter, and joining AS-IS carries that damage), encounter 2 is the Incine-Dile den with the (possibly) grown party. RECRUIT PICK — Sasha 'The Tell' over Nikita, three reasons: (1) party gap — Imani tanks on Physique 5, Dario tricks on Reflexes/Charm 5/5, nobody fields Mind; Sasha's Mind 5 is the only spread that adds a new axis to the demo pair (her own file's stated role). (2) Kit safety vs the slice boss — the Incine-Dile is Mind 1, so her feints can never be read (R24), while Nikita's bruiser kit duplicates Imani's Force role. (3) Frame fit — a casino floor manager who counted cards on her own abductors is the Cosmic Casino slice's most on-theme first recruit. Nikita stays reserved for a later den. All numbers PLACEHOLDER (R14); every spec below is copied VERBATIM from its loadout source and drift-gated by tests/test_run_state.gd (test_demo_run_data_contract).
